summary: Allow merchants to refund a captured payment in one or more parts, never exceeding the captured amount, safely under client retries, with every refund in the ledger and no card data in logs.

acceptance_criteria.then: the refund succeeds, refundedAmount is 3000 paise and the status is PARTIALLY_REFUNDED

acceptance_criteria.given: a payment with INR 60.00 of 100.00 already refunded
acceptance_criteria.when: the merchant requests a further INR 50.00 refund
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is rejected and refundedAmount stays 6000 paise

acceptance_criteria.given: a refund request with idempotency key K
acceptance_criteria.when: the same request with key K is retried
acceptance_criteria.then: the original refund is returned and no second refund or ledger entry is created

acceptance_criteria.given: a payment that is not captured, or an amount that is zero or not whole paise

acceptance_criteria.then: a REFUND ledger entry with the refunded amount exists and no log line contains the card number

tasks.title: Identify impacted modules and define the refund API
Implement partial refunds with idempotency keys
Run unit, acceptance, coverage and lint checks
Security review of the diff (PCI: PAN exposure)
Assemble release evidence and request approval

assumptions: Amounts are integer paise, as in the existing service.
Idempotency keys are unique per payment, not globally.
Existing full-refund behaviour (refundPayment) must keep working.
open_questions: Should partial refunds be limited by the 180-day refund window in config/gateway.config.json? Assumed out of scope for this change.
out_of_scope: Asynchronous refund settlement with the acquirer
